column1: Putting two strings in the right order means moving them — but the array holds pointers. When two strings are out of order, what exactly do you exchange, and does exchanging the pointers move the actual characters? How do you know the whole array is in order, and not just the strings you last compared?

Where does this array stop? It has no length stored anywhere, so something marks the end. What is the very last slot, and how does your loop know not to read past it? What should happen when there is nothing, or only one thing, to sort?
